summary: Backcountry skier Emily broke her lower leg skiing down Culebra Peak after her binding failed to release on a fall; she was immobilized on the slope in high winds for several hours while the ranch rescue team responded
responding_agency: Costilla County SAR (Cielo Vista Ranch rescue team)
notes: Ranch team (Javier plus brothers) rode snowmachines to Four Way, then postholed ~2 mi uphill in deep snow pulling a hunting jet sled; a helicopter was also called per the trip report. Earlier the same day a group member activated a Garmin InReach SOS for a separated skier (Russ), then cancelled it via a 911 call after he self-rescued — no SAR deployment from that activation. | 2026-09-15: 14ers.com link removed per site ban; row retains other verified source(s).
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Culebra Peak)
